scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply younicorn-staging --remote -e staging
scripts.deploy:prod: bun run build:client && wrangler deploy -e production
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run build:client && wrangler deploy -e staging
scripts.dev: concurrently --names CF,Astro "bun run worker" "bun run client"
scripts.dryrun:prod: bun run build:client && wrangler deploy -e production --dry-run
scripts.dryrun:staging: bun run build:client && wrangler deploy -e staging --dry-run
scripts.test: bun run test:db:create && bun test && bun run test:db:delete
